as_told.title: Host's own expedition to the anomaly
as_told.place_text: Baltic Sea, 60 km out between Finland and Sweden

plain: The story is about a strange round object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, out in the open water between Sweden and Finland, that some say looks like a crashed UFO. A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, who found it, says it first appeared on side scan sonar, a device that maps the seabed with sound, on 19 June 2011. He remembers his partner Peter Lindberg and a man named Floris laughing and saying, "Dennis, here is UFO." Michels went out to the site himself in 2025, together with a man named Ammar Kandil, and describes it as about 60 km out at sea, "the epicenter between Finland and Sweden." In another episode Michels says the thing looks like the Millennium Falcon, the flat round spaceship from Star Wars. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells it more distantly, as something she once heard about: a team of divers found something off the Swedish coast that "looked like a crashed UFO or looked like an artificial structure." So the story comes from the finder himself, the host who visited, and a scientist passing on what she heard, and if the object is what it looks like, it would be a wrecked craft lying on the seabed.
